# Equipment Concierge

> Premium, hands-on equipment service for horse farms in Wellington and Palm Beach County, Florida. We inspect, repair, sell, replace and deliver — tractors, golf carts, UTVs, mowers, arena drags, horse trailers and RVs. One call and the equipment is our problem, not yours. Tagline: "Yes. Do it all. Just call us."

## Services
- Evaluate every unit on the farm — keep, fix, sell or replace
- On-farm repairs: hydraulics, batteries, engines, electrical
- Sell what you don't use — cleaned up, sold, cash back to you, clear commission
- Source & deliver new equipment
- Horse-trailer road-ready checks: lights, brakes, fans, tires, hitch, electrical
- Golf cart refresh & repair
- RVs for groom housing — chosen, delivered, installed
- Mini loader rental — by the day or with an operator (call for a quote)

## Brands we service and sell
- Tractors: Kubota, John Deere, Bobcat, New Holland, Massey Ferguson, Mahindra, Case IH, Ford
- UTVs & RTVs: Kubota RTV, John Deere Gator, Polaris Ranger, Can-Am Defender, Kawasaki Mule
- Arena drags: DragNfly / Carolina Arena Equipment, Parma, Land Pride, ABI, Titan
- RVs: Coleman, Winnebago, Coachmen, Forest River, Jayco
- Golf carts: Club Car, E-Z-GO, Yamaha
- Mowers: Kubota, John Deere, Ferris, Exmark, Toro, Grasshopper
- Horse trailers: 4-Star, Bloomer, Cimarron, Exiss, Sundowner, Featherlite

## Service area
Wellington, Loxahatchee, Jupiter Farms and all of Palm Beach County, Florida, plus parts of Martin County, Okeechobee County and western Broward County.
